text: ちいさくて　なげやすい　いわを　もちあげて　あいてに　なげつけて　こうげきする。

structure.jp: ちいさくて　なげやすい　いわを　もちあげて
あいてに　なげつけて

patterns.name: 〜やすい
patterns.explanation: やすい added to a verb says the action is easy to do. なげやすい = 'easy to throw'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て form joins one word or action to the next, like 'and'. The same thing happens with もちあげて and なげつけて later on. ちいさくて　なげやすい = 'small and easy to throw'.
